chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, and Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal, from Abu Jameela, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Firmness (al-hazm) is in the heart, and compassion and harshness are in the liver, and bashfulness (al-haya') is in the lungs. And in another hadith from Abu Jameela: The intellect's dwelling place is in the heart.

key_terms.الْقَلْبِ: The heart (seat of intellect and spirit)

ai.seo_question: Where are the heart, liver, and lungs located according to Shia hadith on moral faculties?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi illustrates the classical Islamic understanding of the human constitution, mapping moral and cognitive faculties to specific organs: firmness (hazm) and intellect (aql) in the heart, while compassion, harshness, and modesty are associated with the liver and lungs. This physiological-spiritual mapping reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating bodily health with ethical refinement, suggesting that inner character is physically embodied. The hadith serves as a practical guide for self-purification, emphasizing that cultivating intellect and firmness begins with the heart's condition.

en.hubeali: H 14666 – Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, and Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzaal, from Abu Jameela, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘الْحَزْمُ’ Firmness is in the heart, and the ‘الرَّحْمَةُ وَ الْغِلْظَةُ’ compassion and the harshness is in the liver, and ‘الْحَيَاءُ’ bashfulness (honour) is in the lungs’. And in another Hadeeth from Abu Jameela, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The intellect dwells in the heart’.
en.sarwar: 218. Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, and Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzaal, from Abu Jameela, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘الْحَزْمُ’ Firmness is in the heart, and the ‘الرَّحْمَةُ وَ الْغِلْظَةُ’ compassion and the harshness is in the liver, and ‘الْحَيَاءُ’ bashfulness (honour) is in the lungs’. And in another Hadeeth from Abu Jameela, he (a.s.) said: ‘The intellect dwells in the heart’.
